parts.say: This is DaVinci Resolve. Let me show you round the Edit page.

parts.name: Pages
parts.say: Resolve is seven rooms in one window. This bar along the bottom is how you move between them.

parts.name: Edit page
parts.say: You are on the Edit page. This is where clips get cut together, and it is where you will spend most of your time.

parts.name: Media Pool
parts.say: Top left is the Media Pool. Every clip you bring into the project lives here. Yours is empty.

parts.name: Viewer
parts.say: Top right is the Viewer. It shows whatever sits under the playhead, or whatever clip you have selected.

parts.name: Play
parts.say: Underneath it are the transport controls. This is play. The space bar does the same thing.

parts.name: Timeline
parts.say: The whole bottom half is the Timeline. Clips sit left to right in the order they play, and the white line is the playhead.

parts.name: Edit tools
parts.say: These small tools are how you change clips. The scissors is the blade. It cuts a clip in two wherever the playhead is.
That is the whole window. Nothing to edit until there is footage, though.

parts.name: Import Media
parts.say: So start here. Double click the empty Media Pool and pick a video from your Mac.

next: Do that, and I will show you how to make your first cut.
